SELECT channel_code, channel_id, s.store_id, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(member_key) with_member, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND (channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_id <> 1 OR s.store_id >= 900 OR channel_code IS NULL OR channel_id IS NULL)

calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.login_state, (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) has_member_line, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) has_member_order, f.channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn_etl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx_etl
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(member_key) with_member, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount END) member_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key<>o.member_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) key_conflict,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND o.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) line_member_order_null,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_member_orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order,
 count(DISTINCT m.tier) tiers, sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outside_validity
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=o.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_net_sales_pct,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS uncorrected_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
